title: Focus lens
description: A moving aperture brings fine silver lines into focus over an ultramarine optical plate.
useCase: Exploring fine imagery, material details, or a progressive focus reveal.
interaction: Move the lens, use arrow keys, or reveal the full artwork
reducedMotion: The aperture follows directly instead of easing. Reveal all provides a still full view.
limitations: Uses a blurred duplicate and radial CSS mask; does not magnify pixels or simulate refraction.
look: Saturated ultramarine field of fine pale silver-blue curved lines and a crescent, blurred except inside a thin circular ring, with an outlined full-width button bar.
motion: A 126 px ring eases toward the pointer with exponential smoothing, opening a sharp aperture in a 13 px-blurred overlay via a moving radial mask; arrow keys move it instantly.
adapt: `tick` eases `point` toward `target` (rate 18 in `Math.exp`) and `paint` writes the `.sf-focus-veil` `maskImage` and ring transform; tune the 82px circle, 52% clear stop and 13px blur. Replace `OpticalPlate` (rendered twice) with your artwork.
